'''"Bravo" Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of nine [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] stationed on [[Vendrak V]]. They participated in a [[Battle on Vendrak V|skirmish]] in a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="RT" />
